summary: The signed D.110c-0c1f2 correction at 1502d4d81e1769a75bc3c416937b53e57dc3390b closes Kimi’s three P1s and the size stop without widening authority. A private digest-keyed (author, authorSequence) map, populated only after the existing exact preimage/digest/signature/anchor/epoch/object/ACL/admission checks and captured with non-anchor key-set/cardinality equality, is sufficient: close need not duplicate signature or preimage bytes, recoveries re-derive identity from those same verified preimages, and census/reclamation with the graph prevent stale or unbounded identity. Owners now cover capture, recovery, adoption (including authenticatedSuccessorIssuanceScope), close, transition, census, and reclamation without changing EpochVertex, public API, dependencies, thresholds, or the wire vertex. The application-writer vector is exactly authorizeLatchedApplicationWrite() for both permissionless (every member) and permissioned (writer-group) snapshots, including successor reopen; non-write-authorized ACL-operation authors get no frontier and fail closed. Aggregate 0→1 seeds the legacy-authenticated creator from v1, starts other writers at null/zero, refuses observed non-creator pre-aggregate gaps, and requires legacy/aggregate creator identity and frontier equality on every coexistence close, with a non-null aggregate entry as the selected capability. The canonical two-element [author, admittedAuthorSequence] tuple is one-to-one with the rejected object form, encodes the legal 64-entry maximum to 6,241 bytes (1,951 under the unchanged 8,192-byte ceiling), and GREEN must reproduce that exact size while rejecting every alternate shape. Fixed signed fields plus prior-aggregate adjacency still bind object, genesis, both ACLs, cut/QC/snapshot, and adjacent epochs under an independent signature domain. The two-layer tests-only RED still fails for the absent aggregate carrier on a genuine two-writer permissioned path, not because tuples or permissionless reopen are unimplemented. Ordinary cold reopen stays O(1) in epoch count and O(current authorized members). Pending/published custody, dense gaps, scan ceilings, two rollback generations, pruning, and runtime reclamation remain fail-closed. D.110c-c/d, archive, repeated-transition, and Phase-7 work stay separately owned. P2 dispositions are frozen and do not block RED.
